_comment: Copy to config.json and fill the THREE values marked FILL after inspecting the DMP-8000. Everything else has a sane default.
_vdcp_port: FILL: TCP (or UDP) port the DMP listens on for VDCP. Set in the DMP protocol/port config. No universal default — read it off the player.
_transport: tcp or udp — must match the DMP's VDCP socket type.
_signal_port: FILL/CONFIRM: the VDCP signal (output) port number that maps to the roof display's Content region.
_open_port_first: Set true only if SELECT PORT alone is rejected (NAK). Sends OPEN PORT first.
_id_mode: fixed8 = 8-char space-padded IDs (default). Switch to 'variable' if the DMP command sign uses longer IDs.

cues._cues: FILL: map friendly name -> the content ID from the DMP command sign (usually named 'Switcher'). 'switcher' should point at the DeckLink Duo (1).dpf entry.
